issue.body:
How should an app configuration be included in Starlette? 

An example use-case:

```python
app = Starlette(config=config)

@app.on_event("startup")
async def open_database_connection_pool():
    await app.config["db"].create_connection()


@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def close_database_connection_pool():
    await app.config["db"].close_connection()
```

I've subclassed the application class locally for including a simple dict parameter to achieve this, but I think we probably want something else here.
issue.title: App config
